name: Armour Shop
desc1: This small, somewhat poorly-kept shop is full of all sorts of armour
desc2: and leather clothing. Most of it is quite shabbily crafted, but some
desc3: of it is good, and some few are even skillfully made. A long wooden
desc4: counter up against the wall displays some of the better wares here.
desc5: The only exit is onto Temple street, to the east.
